name: registry.directory
summary: A directory indexing 91 public shadcn/ui registries and ~27,000 components, installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: The discovery layer for the shadcn/ui registry ecosystem: search the cross-registry index to find which registry holds the component you need, then install it with the shadcn CLI from its origin. Every surface is a plain document built for agents — /llms.txt, /items.json, /directory.json, an OpenAPI-described submission API, and one aggregated /r registry across the whole catalog. Item pages also answer in Markdown when you append .md.
contains: /items.json lists every indexed item; /directory.json lists registries
one aggregated /r registry installable with the shadcn CLI
per-item Markdown by appending .md to an item page URL
submit a registry by form, POST /api/submit or pull request
